name: io.aiflowchart/diagrams
title: AI Flowchart
description: Flowcharts, UML/ER diagrams, mind maps, infographics and SOPs as editable, presentable boards

tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description: Create a diagram in AI Flowchart from a plain-English description and get a link that opens it as an editable board (edit, present as an animated slideshow, export PNG/PDF/PowerPoint). Flowcharts, sequence diagrams and mind maps also come back as Mermaid code. Types: flowchart, mindmap, sequence (API / login flows), erdiagram (database), systemdesign (architecture), swimlane, bpmn (BPMN 2.0 business process), orgchart, uml_class, uml_usecase, uml_state, uml_activity, timeline, gantt (project plan), chart (bar/line/pie… from data you describe). Uses 1 AI credit; advanced types need AI Flowchart Pro.

description.description: What to draw, in detail: the process, system, data, steps or numbers. Include names and specifics from the conversation.

tools.name: create_visual
tools.description: Make a designed infographic of a topic: the AI picks the shape that fits (steps, cycle, timeline, roadmap, funnel, pyramid, hub, tree, comparison, 2×2 matrix or architecture layers), icons and colours, and fills in what a complete picture needs. Use it when the user wants an infographic, a visual, a one-page graphic or a slide graphic of a process, plan, architecture, comparison, timeline or concept, rather than a box-and-arrow diagram. Pass a description of the topic, or the link of a diagram made earlier in this chat to turn that diagram into a visual. Returns a link that opens it in AI Flowchart's Visual view (change the shape, look and colours, edit any part, export PNG/SVG) and a PNG image. Uses 1 AI credit.

description.description: The topic in detail: the stages, parts, options or events to show, with names and specifics from the conversation. Leave out only when diagram is given.

diagram.description: Optional: link (https://aiflowchart.io/import/<id>) or id of a flowchart, mind map, sequence, swimlane, BPMN, system design or ER diagram made earlier, to draw as a visual.

tools.name: code_to_flowchart
tools.description: Turn source code (C, C++, Java, Python or JavaScript, up to 80 lines) into a lab-record style flowchart where every box is linked to its code lines, plus a step-by-step dry run for a sample input (current line, box and variables at each step). Returns a link that opens it ready to play (▶ Explain), the program output and Mermaid code. Uses 1 AI credit.

code.description: The program or function, as source code.

sample_input.description: Optional input for the dry run, e.g. "n = 5". Picked automatically if left out.

tools.name: edit_diagram
tools.description: Change a diagram made earlier in this chat with create_diagram: add, remove, rename or reconnect steps, shorten labels, recolour, restructure. Pass its link (https://aiflowchart.io/import/…) and the change in plain English. Use this instead of create_diagram whenever the user wants to adjust a diagram they already have, so their earlier work is kept. Returns a link to the new version plus Mermaid code where available. Uses 1 AI credit.

diagram.description: The diagram link from an earlier result (https://aiflowchart.io/import/<id>) or just the id.

instruction.description: What to change, e.g. "add a refund step after payment", "make the labels shorter", "remove the approval loop".

tools.name: create_sop
tools.description: Write a standard operating procedure (SOP) for a business process: purpose, scope, roles and responsibilities, numbered steps with who does each one and what to do at each decision, and a RACI matrix. Use it when the user wants an SOP, work instruction, procedure document, process documentation, RACI or onboarding guide for a process. Pass a process diagram link from an earlier result (flowchart, swimlane or BPMN), or a description of the process and it is drawn first. The steps and roles always match the diagram. Returns the SOP as Markdown plus a link that opens it next to the diagram in AI Flowchart. Uses 1 AI credit.

diagram.description: Link (https://aiflowchart.io/import/<id>) or id of a flowchart, swimlane or BPMN diagram made earlier. Leave out to use description.

description.description: Only when there is no diagram yet: the process in detail — the steps in order, who does each (roles/teams), decisions and their outcomes.

tools.name: simulate_process
tools.description: Run a process diagram (flowchart, swimlane or BPMN made earlier) through AI Flowchart's process simulator — a real discrete-event simulation, not an AI guess — to find how long each case takes, the cost per case, how busy each team is and where the bottleneck is, with a suggestion. Use it when the user asks how long a process takes, where it gets stuck, how many staff they need, or what happens at a given volume. Pass the numbers the user gives (cases per day, people per team, minutes per step); anything missing uses clear defaults that are listed in the answer. Returns the results plus a link that opens the simulator on the diagram. Free — no AI credits.

diagram.description: Link (https://aiflowchart.io/import/<id>) or id of a flowchart, swimlane or BPMN diagram made earlier.

cases_per_day.description: New cases (orders, tickets, claims…) arriving per working day. Default 20.

cost_per_hour.description: Staff cost per hour, in the user's currency. Default 20.

staff.description: People per lane/team, as the user said. Swimlanes: one entry per lane name. Flowcharts: a single entry for the whole team.

lane.description: Lane / team name as on the diagram.

step_minutes.description: How long steps take, in minutes of work, as the user said. Optional min/max for a range.

step.description: Step label as on the diagram.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List AI Flowchart's ready-made templates (lab programs, UML and ER for student projects, system designs, charts, app walkthroughs, code programs…). Free — no AI credits.

type.description: Optional board type to filter by, e.g. flowchart, erdiagram, sequence, mindmap, systemdesign, chart, codeflow, walkthrough.

tools.name: open_template
tools.description: Get a link that opens one of the templates (from list_templates) as a new editable board. Free — no AI credits.

tools.name: render_diagram
tools.description: Turn Mermaid diagram text into a hosted PNG and SVG image URL (cached on a CDN). Use it when a diagram has to go somewhere that cannot run Mermaid: email, Slack or Teams messages, PDFs, Word/Google Docs, Confluence, WhatsApp, a README. Returns the URLs plus ready-made Markdown and HTML. Free — no AI credits.

mermaid.description: Mermaid source, e.g. "flowchart TD\n  A[Start] --> B{OK?}"

style.description: "aiflowchart" (default) draws it in AI Flowchart's polished board style; "mermaid" gives the classic Mermaid look. Unsupported diagram types fall back to classic automatically.
